_what: Which road an owner answers, as DATA, for the shared shell. A road with shown: false is switched off: its control is not drawn and its code stays, so switching it on restores it. waits_for names what must exist before the road is switched on.

queue.waits_for: a road that carries a job to the person's AIs and an owner answers (the queue road has no owner now)

previews.waits_for: a files operation that makes previews on the server (none answers now; the old previews road has no owner)

share_destinations.waits_for: a road that answers the person's share list (where a share goes and what their AI does with it); until then the message box sends to every AI on the account, as one seed row (send-to-seeds.json)
